provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: The legend only covers 1 to 4 holes, which is the constructor's domain. Outside it, the program mimics the archived fallback by using palette[n] for n up to 9 and otherwise keeps the original colour. The background is assumed to be palette[0], a fixed property of the task, rather than inferred from frequency. The demonstrations are not used, since the legend is fixed. None of this has been run or tested by me. I found no contradiction between the fixtures and the uniform rule.
